channel.title: Paksh: Environment
channel.description: Compare how India's media, left, centre and right, covers each story, side by side.

item.title: Northeast US braces for weekend nor'easter storm
item.description: A powerful nor'easter storm is forecast to impact the Northeast United States, including New York and Boston, over the weekend. Forecasters warn of potential wind gusts up to 70 mph, significant flooding, beach erosion, and power outages… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 0 · Right 0.

item.title: US Pledges $31 Million for Nepal Flood Recovery and Preparedness
item.description: The United States has announced a $31 million aid package for Nepal to support flood recovery efforts and enhance disaster preparedness. The announcement comes in the wake of a significant flood event in Nepal, prompting experts to… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: California Declares El Niño Emergency
item.description: California has declared a state of emergency in anticipation of a potentially historic El Niño weather event. The declaration was made ahead of the expected arrival of the phenomenon. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Nagaland revises Biodiversity Strategy and Action Plan
item.description: Nagaland has begun the process of revising its State Biodiversity Strategy and Action Plan. This initiative requires a collective effort for biodiversity conservation in the state, according to the Principal Secretary. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Environmentalist Bittu Tabahi Cleans Yamuna River Bank in Delhi
item.description: Environmentalist Bittu Sahgal, also known as Bittu Tabahi, conducted a cleanup mission along the Yamuna river bank in Delhi. In 4.5 hours, he and local volunteers removed 585 kg of waste from the riverbank. The mission extended from the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Hurricane Polo Intensifies to Category 5 Storm
item.description: Hurricane Polo has rapidly intensified into a Category 5 storm off Mexico's Pacific coast. It is expected to bring heavy rain to parts of southwestern Mexico, including Guerrero and Michoacán, through Thursday. The storm's rapid… Coverage: Left 5 · Centre 16 · Right 0.

item.title: Super El Niño may cause 450,000 deaths, 15,800 in India, researchers say
item.description: Researchers from the Climate Impact Lab at the University of Chicago estimate that the current 'Super' El Niño could lead to about 450,000 excess deaths worldwide, with the highest mortality expected in poorer nations that are already… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 10 · Right 1.

item.title: Massive Fire Engulfs Mercedes Workshop in Jaipur, 8 Cars Destroyed
item.description: A major fire broke out at a Mercedes-Benz workshop in Sitapura, Jaipur, late Tuesday night. The blaze destroyed 8 luxury cars, along with expensive parts and accessories. Over 50 new and old cars were present in the workshop at the time of… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Bihar Floods Impact Over 50 Lakh People Across 15 Districts
item.description: Floods in Bihar have affected over 50.49 lakh people across 15 districts. The inundation has impacted 576 gram panchayats. Relief camps and community kitchens are providing aid to those affected. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 3 · Right 1.

item.title: Maharashtra CM visits drought-hit areas, promises farmer relief
item.description: Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis visited drought-affected areas in Latur, a region experiencing significant crop loss and water shortages. He promised relief to farmers who were seen breaking down during his visit. The visit… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Typhoon Dujuan Causes Deaths and Missing in Japan
item.description: Typhoon Dujuan made landfall in Japan, bringing torrential rains and landslides. At least four people have died, and six are reported missing. The typhoon's impact was felt a day after it made landfall. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Karnataka Farmers Face Crop Losses Due to Deficient Rainfall
item.description: Farmers in Karnataka's Mandya district are experiencing the effects of deficient rainfall on their ragi crops. In Davangere, approximately 75% of the maize crop has been lost due to the rainfall deficit, though ragi is considered more… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Scientists warn of severe El Niño risk to India within six months
item.description: Scientists forecast a super El Niño developing within six months that could threaten up to 4.51 lakh lives and create a major crisis for India, according to the coverage. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: 20 Dead, 115 Missing After Indonesian Ferry Sinks
item.description: The death toll from the sinking of the Virgo Transport 8 ferry in Indonesia's Java Sea has risen to 20, with 115 people still missing. The ferry was carrying 243 people, including 30 crew members, when it sank 10 days ago. Search efforts… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Delhi Air Quality Worsens as Monsoon Withdraws, Winter Pollution Looms
item.description: Delhi's Air Quality Index (AQI) has risen to 151 following the withdrawal of the monsoon season. This marks the beginning of the winter pollution cycle, with authorities planning pollution control measures for the upcoming season. On… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Climate Disasters Increase Amidst Program Funding Cuts
item.description: The frequency and intensity of climate-related disasters are increasing, coinciding with reductions in funding for programs designed to prepare for such events. This trend is observed across various regions, highlighting a growing… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 1.

item.title: Heavy Rain Triggers Weather Alerts Across Multiple Indian States
item.description: Heavy rain and thunderstorms were reported in several Indian states on the same day. In Kanpur, black dense clouds covered the sky from the morning and cold winds were expected to blow throughout the day. In Chhattisgarh, authorities… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 2.

item.title: Two Killed in Helicopter Crash Fighting Yosemite Wildfire
item.description: A helicopter crashed while fighting a wildfire in Yosemite, killing two people. The incident occurred while the individuals were engaged in efforts to combat the blaze. Coverage: Left 3 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Typhoon Dujuan Hits Japan, Causing Fatalities and Disruptions
item.description: Typhoon Dujuan made landfall in Japan, bringing heavy rains and strong winds that led to flood and landslide warnings. The storm caused at least five deaths and left six people missing, according to various reports. Approximately 45,000… Coverage: Left 4 · Centre 13 · Right 1.

item.title: Potential Nor'easter Threatens US East Coast with Rain and Wind
item.description: A nor'easter, an unusual storm for September, is forecast to impact the US East Coast this week. As of Tuesday, there remained uncertainty regarding the storm's exact trajectory and intensity. Forecasters anticipate potential rain, wind… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Lithium-ion Battery Fire Prompts Evacuations in La Verne
item.description: A fire involving lithium-ion batteries in La Verne led to evacuations of a neighborhood and a school. Authorities issued evacuation orders due to the hazardous nature of the fire. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: UN Chief Criticizes Fossil Fuel Companies Over Climate Impact
item.description: United Nations Secretary-General António Guterres has stated that major fossil fuel companies treat the atmosphere like an "open sewer." He expressed regret over world leaders' inaction on climate change and asserted that oil and gas firms… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: India and Bhutan Collaborate on Rhino Conservation
item.description: On World Rhino Day, India and Bhutan's joint conservation efforts for the one-horned rhino were highlighted. A translocation program in Manas Tiger Reserve increased the rhino population from zero to 48 over 20 years. However, increased… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Nainital water contamination leads to engineer suspensions, two deaths
item.description: The Statesman reported that Uttarakhand Chief Minister Pushkar Dhami said the government had taken action and that six engineers were suspended over the water supply issue in Nainital. The Pioneer reported that the same six engineers were… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Landslide and Floods Hit Kerala's Vattavada Region
item.description: A landslide occurred in Vattavada, Kerala, following heavy rainfall. The region, typically a rain shadow area, experienced significant flooding. The coverage questions the reasons behind the heavy rain impacting this specific area. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Rain offers relief to delta farmers facing water scarcity
item.description: Consecutive days of rainfall have provided relief to farmers in the Cauvery delta districts, meeting the initial irrigation needs for crops. This comes amid concerns over reduced Cauvery water reaching the fields under the turn system… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: UN Warns of El Niño Impacts: Disease, Hunger, Extreme Heat
item.description: The United Nations has issued a warning regarding the impacts of El Niño, citing concerns about increased disease, hunger, and extreme heat. Separately, ocean temperatures have recorded 100 consecutive days of extreme heat, with reports… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: China Textile Factory Fire Kills 8
item.description: A fire broke out at a textile factory in the southern Chinese city of Foshan, resulting in the deaths of 8 people. One person was injured, and rescue operations were ongoing. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Children to face double extreme fire weather in Europe: study
item.description: Children born after 2025 in Europe are projected to experience nearly twice the amount of extreme fire weather compared to their great-grandparents, according to a study. This intensification of fire-conducive weather is linked to… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Ten lions dead from suspected poisoning in Tanzania
item.description: Ten lions were discovered dead in a wildlife reserve in Tanzania, with authorities suspecting poisoning as the cause. Concerns have been raised regarding the conservation of large mammals within the reserve. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Bengaluru experiences overnight rain, temperatures drop
item.description: Bengaluru recorded overnight rainfall, with the Kempegowda International Airport (KIA) weather station registering 94.2 mm of rain. The precipitation brought down temperatures that had been above 30°C for the preceding two weeks. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: N.L. Fishers Seek Access to Northward-Migrating Lobster Stocks
item.description: Some fishers in Newfoundland and Labrador (N.L.) are seeking more lobster licenses to access lobster populations that are moving north due to climate change. These fishers believe that expanding licenses could stimulate rural fishing… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Avalanche on Mt. Manaslu kills German climber of Indian origin, Nepali guide
item.description: An avalanche at Mt. Manaslu has resulted in the deaths of a German climber of Indian origin and a Nepali guide. Their bodies were recovered from 7 feet of snow at the mountain's camp. The incident occurred at Manaslu's camp. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 0 · Right 2.

item.title: Climate Week Summit Highlights Energy Transition Challenges
item.description: Climate Week has issued warnings about the difficulties in achieving the energy transition. Discussions at the summit, including panels on climate infrastructure, the climate economy, and the gas reset, focused on the challenges of… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Cuba's Electrical Grid Collapses, Causing Nationwide Blackout
item.description: Cuba's electrical grid collapsed on Friday, resulting in a nationwide blackout. This marks the latest in a series of at least six partial or total grid failures this year. The island nation is experiencing ongoing difficulties with its… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 6 · Right 2.

item.title: Hurricane Maria's Impact on Puerto Rico Recalled
item.description: Hurricane Maria, a destructive storm, made landfall in Puerto Rico. The event is remembered for its lasting impact on the island. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Chicago Area Under Flood Watch Until Saturday Afternoon
item.description: A Flood Watch is in effect for the Chicago area until 1 p.m. on Saturday. The watch warns of potential flash flooding. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Congress MP Jairam Ramesh alleges threat to Aravallis from Centre's actions
item.description: Congress leader Jairam Ramesh has stated that the Aravalli mountain range is under "gravest of threats" due to actions by the Modi government. He specifically cited the Centre's redefinition moves as a cause for concern. The New Indian… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: US National Parks Face Staffing, Culture War Challenges
item.description: America's national parks are experiencing significant staffing shortages, leading to traffic jams and contributing to a "culture war" within the park system. Firefighters are also struggling with shortages of staff and equipment amidst a… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: UK braces for late summer heatwave with temperatures reaching 26C
item.description: The United Kingdom is expected to experience a late summer heatwave with temperatures potentially reaching 26 degrees Celsius. The Independent reported that temperatures could hit 24C, while Metro.co.uk indicated a possibility of 26C. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.
